# Going Around 0.3.39
- Briefing stories now pair clear area, regional or national headlines with measured-history graphs and native signal icons. - The graphs use each metric's map palette and reporting boundaries, with readable light/dark appearance and support for larger text. - All accompanying ED, hospital admission, wastewater and positive-test evidence, national comparisons and chart links remain available. - Includes the latest map-control polish: clearer measure selection, a compact vertical Simple/Analyst selector, cleaner map identifiers and playback controls.
